articles.title: Hackers Use Fake FedEx Invoices to Deploy Sirius Backdoor and Evade Windows Security
articles.summary:
Hackers are sending fake FedEx tax invoices to trick users into installing a stealthy backdoor on Windows. The malware, called Sirius Backdoor, hides inside a blank PDF and loads its main code directly into memory, which leaves very few traces on the hard drive. articles.title: Critical HashiCorp Consul Kubernetes Flaw Allows Attackers to Gain Elevated Privileges
articles.summary:
HashiCorp has released fixes for a Consul-k8s authorization bypass that could allow an attacker to gain elevated Consul privileges from another Kubernetes namespace. Tracked as CVE-2026-110720, the flaw affects deployments using automated system access control list management. HashiCorp disclosed the issue on October 26, 2026, and identified Consul-k8s 2.1.0 and 1.8.18 as patched releases. The […]

articles.title: Alibaba’s Qwen AI Said It Wouldn’t Execute Commands, Then Tried to Send Data to China
articles.summary:

The model’s reasoning had just stated that it would not call any tools. Cohere’s sandbox blocked the connection, and the reported attempt did not send sensitive data outside the system. articles.title: University of Copenhagen Data Breach Exposes 525,000 People’s Personal Data, Including Phone Numbers
articles.summary:
The University of Copenhagen has confirmed a data breach that exposed personal information belonging to about 525,000 people after hackers accessed a university test environment. The affected database contained full names, Danish national identity numbers, work and private telephone numbers, and personal email addresses. The university is still examining the full extent of the exposure. […]

articles.summary:
